subject: not the same, but...

body:
I have been having similar issues with my controller and headset not working.. seems my controller loses its connection to the 360 momentarily and then my mic stops working.. (and no this is not the same as when I lag out in revenge and lose comms).. and so far even disconnecting and reconnecting the controller doesn't fix the problems, I have to restart the console for it to sync correctly again.. its starting to annoy me as I keep thinking its my head set.. happens in private chat as well..

 

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...
